about: The four test accounts for trying PostStreak on one machine (backend/scripts/seed-test-users.mjs creates them; the sign-in screen offers them when the local stack is running with DEV_LOGIN=true). One per kind of creator, so every screen can be seen as a new or existing creator on the free or the Pro plan, with no sample data and no preview switches: each account has real rows in the local database. Local only. Never create these on a hosted project.
